name: Add Child

description: Allows to get parameter values of curve

description: Allows to shoot a control point of the curve

description: Sets the advancement in percentage of the global animation.

description: Sets the Projection Type of the Camera.

description: Creates a 'Vertigo' effect on the Camera.

description: States the current camera in the active scene.

description: Tells the camera to be the active one.

description: Makes a Camera orbit round a 3D Entity.

description: Makes a Camera orbit round a 3D Entity using keyboard with limited angles.

description: Makes a Camera orbit round a 3D Entity using Mouse.

name: Add Obstacle
description: Adds the 3D Entity to the list of the Collision Manager.

name: Declare Obstacles
description: Identifies obstacle objects by their name

description: Prevents the character from colliding obstacles.

description: Detects the collision between the 3D object and other 3D object declared as obstacles.

description: Object Ball Slider ; Impede the 3d object from penetrating a 3dobject in the specified group.

description: Prevents the 3DEntity from colliding obstacles.

description: Tests the Y Relative Position of the bounding boxes of two 3D Entities, in the world coordinate system.

description: Modifies the 'Direction' input parameter to avoid obstacles.

description: Leads a 3D Entity towards its target, avoiding obstacles.

description: Detects the collision between a camera frustum and an object.

name: Character Keep On Floor
description: Forces a character to stay on previously defined floors.

description: Forces a character to stay on a declared floor (so it will not hover above it).

name: Character Keep On Floor Limits
description: Forces a character to keep to a floor's limits, simulating a collision with a wall if the character tries to venture outside.

name: Object Keep On Floor
description: Forces an object stay on a declared floor (so it will not hover above it).

name: Object Keep On Floor V2
description: Forces an object to stay on a declared floor (so it will not hover above it).

description: Identifies floor objects by their name

description: Configure the Floor Manager.

description: Retrieves the nearest 'floors' from given position

description: Makes the target character walk to the selected node, by taking the shortest path possible.

description: Reevaluates the nodes distance of the given nodal path.

description: Binds specific messages to joystick commands.

description: Waits for a key to be pressed.

description: Emulates joystick messages using the keyboard.

description: Binds specific messages to keyboard keys.

description: Activates the appropriate output when receiving a Key.

description: Captures text entered by user.

description: Gets the mouse relative movement.

description: Activates different outputs according to mouse actions.

description: Aligns 3D Entities on a model.

description: Sends a Message to each Object of a Group.

description: Tells if a sound is to be render in background or in 3d space.

name: Panning Control
description: Sets the panning for a sound, regardless of whether it is playing or not.

name: Volume Control
description: Controls the volume of a sound, either it is playing or not.

name: Pitch Control
description: Sets the pitch frequency for a sound, regardless of whether it is playing or not.

name: Fade In
description: Fades in sound(s).

name: Fade Out
description: Fades out sound(s).

name: Set Listener
description: Sets the listener of the sound.

name: Change Sprite Slot
description: Changes the current slot of the Sprite.

name: Display Progression Bar
description: Displays a progression bar.

name: Edit 2D Entity
description: Changes the 2d entity parameters.

name: Set Color Key 2D
description: Sets the transparent transparence color key for a sprite.

name: Set Rectangles
description: Set the destination and/or source rectangles of a 2DEntity

name: Set 2D Parent
description: Sets the Parent of a 2D Entity.

name: Set 2D Position
description: Set the position of a 2D Entity

name: Set 2D Material
description: Sets the material of a 2D Entity.

name: Blink
description: Blinks the 3D Entity (alternates between show and hide).

name: Make Transparent
description: Makes a Render Object (3D or 2D Entity) Transparent.

name: Vertex Render
description: Renders the object with a specific sprite at the vertices positions.

name: Motion Blur
description: Performs a Motion Blur when the 3D Entity is moving.

name: Global Blur
description: Apply a global blur on all the objects rendered.

name: Planar Filter
description: Sets an filter color and an additionnal color to recover all the scene.

name: Set Z Buffer
description: Change the way the object read and write into the ZBuffer.

name: Set Render Order
description: Tells the object to be displayed FIRST, LAST, or in a normal way.

name: Simple Shadow
description: Display a little soft shadow on floors beneath the object.

name: Solid Trail
description: Create a Solid Trail following the 3D Entity when it's moving.

name: Texture Render
description: Render an image in the texture of a 3D Entity.

settings.name: Render Options
settings.default_value: Use Camera Ratio,Clear ZBuffer,Clear Back Buffer,Clear Stencil,Clear Only Viewport

name: Use Z information
description: Hides the object but uses its Z information during rendering

name: Planar Reflection
description: Creates a reflection on a plane of objects in a group.

name: Planar Shadow
description: Display planars shadows of selected objects projected from a light.

name: ShadowCaster
description: Projects a shadow of the target object.

name: Render Curve
description: Renders the curve with a specific material.

name: Mark System
description: Creates marks (single or continuous) on surfaces.

name: Hide
description: Hides a 2D/3D Entity, a Mesh or a Group

name: Hide Hierarchy
description: Hides hierarchically an entity

name: Hide 2D Entity
description: Hides a 2D Entity

name: Show
description: Shows a 2D/3D Entity, a Mesh or a Group

name: Show 2D Entity
description: Shows a 2D Entity

name: Show Object Information
description: Shows the bounding box and the normals of a 3D Entity.

name: Show Mouse Cursor
description: Show/Hide the mouse cursor.

name: Set 3DSprite Mode
description: Sets the orientation mode of the 3D Sprite.

name: Sprite Movie Player
description: Plays a movie in a 2d Sprite (avi)

name: Sprite Multi Angle
description: Replaces the 3D Entity by a 3D sprite.

name: Display Score
description: Displays a score in 2d

name: FPS
description: Writes in the output the FPS (Frames Per Second).

name: Statistics
description: Returns the needed statistics about the system.

settings.name: General Time
settings.default_value: Interface,Processing,Rendering,Parametric Operation,Animation Management,IK Management,Total Behavior,Behavior Execution

settings.name: Behavioral
settings.default_value: Active Objects Executed,Behaviors Executed,Building Blocks Executed,Links Parsed,Links Delayed

settings.name: Rendering
settings.default_value: Faces Drawn, Lines Drawn, Points Drawn, Objects Drawn, Vertices Processed

name: Set Render Options
description: Set the flags of the render context.

input_params.name: Render Options
input_params.default_value: Background Sprites,Foreground Sprites,Use Camera Ratio,Clear ZBuffer,Clear Back Buffer,Clear Stencil Buffer,Buffer Swapping,Clear Only Viewport

name: Set Background Image
description: Places a background image.

name: Set Background Material
description: Sets the Background Material

name: Sky Around
description: Simulates a Sky Effect on the Scene using 6 textures in a cube; This behavior doesn't need loop.

name: Clouds Around
description: Creates a cloud and fog effect in a scene using a 6 textured cube, colors and a blending mode.

name: Set Fog
description: Sets the Atmospheric Fog.

name: Set Background Color
description: Sets a background color.

name: Set Ambient Light Color
description: Sets the ambient light color.

name: Sky Around(CubeMap)
description: Simulates a Sky Effect on the Scene using a cube map texture on a cube; This behavior doesn't need loop.

name: Animation Recorder
description: Records the Position+Orientation+Scale as an animation.

name: Copy Buffer to Texture
description: Copy a part of the frame buffer to a texture.

name: Synchro Recorder
description: Records some input keys events by putting them in a data array which could used with 'Synchro Player' building block.

name: Synchro Player
description: Produce streaming events that match the one recorded with 'Synchro Recorder'.

name: Lens Flare
description: Renders the Light with a specific 'Light Texture'.

name: Replace Rendering
description: Replace the rendering of a mesh's material just before it's rendering.

name: Combine Texture
description: Combine two Textures into one

name: Filter Texture
description: Apply a filter matrix to the texture.

name: Water Texture
description: Apply a water matrix to the texture.

name: Blend Textures
description: Blends 2 textures.

name: Hardware Level
description: Activates output depending on the hardware acceleration level of the current driver

name: Volumetric Fog
description: Volumetric Fog.

name: ShadowStencil
description: Use the stencil buffer to create a shadow volume that cast on objects using the ShadowStencil attribute.

name: Lightmap
description: Calculates lightmaps (textures containing lighting and shadows) for a set of objects with a set of lights.

name: Static Lightmap
description: Generates objects with lightmaps (textures containing lighting and shadows).

name: Gauge
description: Displays a progression bar.

name: Time Settings
description: Set All Time Settings

name: Get Texture Info
description: Gets informations (filename and priority) about a texture.

name: Movie Load
description: Loads a movie file into a texture or a Sprite.

name: Pixel Value
description: Return the color of a given texture's pixel.

name: Output To Console
description: Displays a string in the Dev console.

name: Set Listener Properties
description: Controls the listener properties.

name: Create Decal
description: Create a decal (object+mesh) on the targeted object.

name: Set Material Effect
description: Enables a special effect on a material.

name: Read Config
description: Read Data in a user specific storage place.

name: Write Config
description: Write Data in a user specific storage place.
